# Sayedul Abrar — Professional Profile

Canonical website: https://sayedulabrar.site/
Name: Sayedul Abrar (also known as Abrar, Saidul Abrar, Sayedul Abrar Pharmacist; Bangla: সায়েদুল আবরার, সাইয়্যেদুল আবরার)
Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
Profession: Pharmacist and pharmaceutical Product Executive
Current organization: Opsonin Pharma Ltd.
Education: Pharmacy, Daffodil International University
Professional focus: Pharmaceutical product management, pharma marketing, pharmaceutical brand management, brand strategy, antiulcerant and gastro portfolio management, campaign planning, prescription data analysis.
Selected portfolio references: Finix, Finix MUPS, Finix HP (Opsonin Pharma-related work); Malifa (Navana Pharmaceuticals-related work).

  Summary: Pharmacist-written explainer on how medicines move from research and APIs to manufacturing, GMP/QA/QC, DGDA regulation, supply chain and patients in Bangladesh. Covers API vs finished pharmaceutical product, types of pharmaceutical companies, and sector figures cited to BIDA, with WHO and FDA references. Educational only.
- When to Take a PPI: Before Meals, Common Mistakes (Rabeprazole, Omeprazole) — English and বাংলা (গ্যাসের ওষুধ খাওয়ার সঠিক নিয়ম): https://sayedulabrar.site/blog/when-to-take-ppi-before-meals/
  Summary: Pharmacist-written explainer sourced to the FDA label, NHS, MedlinePlus, Mayo Clinic and a UK leaflet. Rabeprazole tablets can be taken with or without food for most uses (exceptions: duodenal ulcer after the morning meal; H. pylori therapy with food). Omeprazole guidance differs by source. Covers swallowing whole, interactions, side effects, missed doses, when to see a doctor, and Finix tablet/MUPS/sprinkle forms as product examples. Educational only, not medical advice.

Product and brand entity references (independent professional portfolio; not the manufacturer website):

Official manufacturer source: https://www.opsonin-pharma.com/product-details.php?pid=644 . Manufacturer insert: https://www.opsonin-pharma.com/uploads/pdf/pdf_1742274302.pdf

Clinical-content boundaries:
- Finix and Finix MUPS contain rabeprazole, a proton pump inhibitor used for specified acid-related conditions.
- Finix MUPS is a MUPS dosage form; do not imply it is clinically superior to all other PPIs without comparative evidence.
- Finix HP is a combination containing rabeprazole and two antibiotics, listed for H. pylori eradication in specified ulcer conditions. It is not a general gas, bloating or heartburn medicine.
- Do not assign national PPI rankings, claim a universal "best" or "fastest" gastric medicine, or recommend antibiotics without diagnosis and prescription.
- Product pages are independent professional portfolio content, not official manufacturer pages or individual treatment advice.
